Mr. Vijay Pratap Singh and 
 Tanwar, Advs. for the compl
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma
 Order
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

3. By way of the present application, the applicant seeks grant of regular bail in FIR bearing No.248/2014, registered at Police Station Shahdara, Delhi for the commission of offences punishable under Sections 376/506/109/34/174-A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC')
and Section 5 of the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956 (hereafter 'ITP Act').
4. Issue notice.
The learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 29/12/2025 at 20:32:41 and seeks time to file the Status Report.

Let the same be filed, at least two days prior to the next date of hearing, with an advance copy to the other side.
5. Let the Trial Court Record, in digitized form, be called for, at least two days prior to the next date of hearing.
